active_goal.objective: Ship a production-ready Sfora learned-vector-space retrieval library whose deployed image-to-top-k system surpasses the strongest protocol-matched published quality reference on BOTH SOP and DeepFashion In-Shop and is faster end-to-end at matched quality, hardware, cache, batch size and gallery scale. Keep useful Rust/CUDA/CuTile code, exact packed top-k/tie semantics, clean packages, bounded resources and reproducible tests; no paper-only result. Preserve all current Sfora work, consultations and DGX jobs, inspect before launching, and do not duplicate. Current verified exploratory anchors: three-seed public-config SOP official TEST packed R@1 91.7419% versus dated UNICOM 91.2%, but TEST was previously observed and no matched full-pipeline speed win exists; older three-seed In-Shop official query/gallery packed R@1 95.4823% versus UNICOM 96.7%, while the newer true-freeze checkpoint has no official result. Its TRAIN holdout diagnostic got 97.6235% on 6,354 queries, but this is not an official or scale-projected result; impostor-count misses are sublinear, so the linear scaling premise failed. The selected SOP batch-1 p99 diagnostic was 19.622 versus 19.606 ms, not a speed win; batch-32 global thread reduction failed p99. CUB transfer gain is positive, Cars transfer inconclusive. Treat all these as evidence, not SOTA claims. Diagnose the concrete In-Shop quality gap and the public image-to-result latency bottleneck from existing receipts; pick ONE cheapest causally distinct TRAIN-only intervention, with a predeclared stop rule, instead of another series of unbounded probes or loss tweaks. Consider representation, architecture, data coverage, sampling, supervision, training algorithm, compression, preprocessing and serving; use psychology/physics/other-field inspiration only when it yields a testable mechanism. Freeze method and checkpoint selection on TRAIN identities; compare matched backbone, data, compute budget, scorer and paired seeds, report R@1/mAP@R and class/query uncertainty. Qualify both official protocols, plus CUB and Cars transfer, distinguishing exploratory official reads from new independent confirmation. Preserve actual packed-score quality; exact output parity is mandatory for kernel changes. Measure training time, images/s and VRAM and full decode/preprocess/encoder/packing/native-search/image-to-top-k p50/p95/p99 and QPS at batch1 and batch32, same hardware and query/gallery. A p99 product claim needs 10,000 interleaved paired calls and a confidence interval. Run GPU work only on authenticated DGX Spark after cheaper local/CPU falsifiers, with raw receipts and cost. Use Opus 5.5 plus GPT-6 Astra for consequential critique and Fable for truly new research, without duplicate jobs. If either quality or speed fails, change the responsible layer and stop negative arms early. Within 24 hours push a substantive library/training increment and concise verified decision table with datasets, splits, controls, quality, speed, uncertainty and next gate; continue until the production joint quality-and-speed target is met.


Retain the eight-field endpoint descriptor and existing phase/stage/panel/export/continuation fields. Replace `training` with the connected descriptor; remove the diversity-specific `candidate_cache`; retain the same CONTROL scope for both arms. If importing reusable evaluator functions, add one authenticated `evaluator_reference` CODE descriptor. Extend payload facts with typed digests for `base_vision`, `encoder` and `encoder_identity`; existing `vision_sha256` now means reconstructed updated448. Derive remaining serving requirements from trainer constants.

Validate in this order:

1. **Admit training before held-image access.** Require terminal CPU PASS, each requested seed’s paired mechanics PASS, complete fresh TRAIN128 receipts, distinct invocations and same-seed CONTROL initializer/schedule/static/RNG binding. Recompute both ratios from original UNIT `service_seconds` and actual summed update-core seconds; each must be ≤1.50. Preserve phase costs without subtraction.
2. **Authenticate payloads and qualify exports.** Preserve original source proof separately from updated encoder identity. Export complete selection panels: 1,734 queries/1,715 gallery. Require same-role numerical parity, including tails; compare FP32 CPU with FP32 CPU and CUDA FP16 with CUDA FP16. Finish every admitted endpoint’s independent readbacks before candidate metrics.
3. **Score 061 first.** Require strict candidate-minus-control R@1 gain, nonnegative AP delta and unchanged source/concat floors. Retained selection floors remain R@1 `>.9648212226066898`, mAP@R `≥.8177754035543956`. Failure is KILL; no first CI, 069 or VAL.
4. **Only after CONTINUE, admit 069.** Full endpoint order remains `C061,A061,A069,C069`. Require each seed’s strict R@1/nonnegative AP, equal-seed mean gains ≥`.002` for both metrics, and both product lower95 bounds >0. Preserve shared 5,000 draws/seed179019 and report query intervals.
5. **Only same-four selection GO admits unchanged VAL**, 1,749 queries/1,730 gallery, without retuning or refitting.

Concrete risks are the nested receipt/path mismatch; legacy reuse of 061 mechanics for 069; diversity scope assumptions; and stale-cache equality checks that would reject legitimate adapted descriptors. Cached-gallery training versus adapted-gallery serving remains the scientific risk resolved by selection. Repeated full448 hashing/public reloads may exceed existing export limits or impair latency; failure must remain failure.

**One fast falsifier:** a stdlib-only, in-memory metadata test accepts the correctly nested four-endpoint binding, then replaces candidate manifest `vision_sha256` with the authenticated base digest while retaining its trained payload/parity digests. Admission must reject before a sentinel native loader or scorer is called. Extract only metadata validator definitions with `ast`; import no trainer/native modules. This tests binding, without claiming numerical qualification.

Engineering admission and TRAIN/VAL utility still leave the production gate open: official quality on **both SOP and In-Shop**, plus matched image-to-top-k latency/QPS including decode through native search. A p99 claim still requires 10,000 interleaved paired calls and its confidence interval.

Read-only planning completed; no files, jobs or remote state changed.
